candidates.sentence: One of the key ideas of cultural analytics is to combine two directions of analysis: top-down analysis using existing categories and bottom-up analysis using extracted continuous features.
candidates.after: Bottom-up here means extracting features and then visualizing the phenomenon using these features.

candidates.before: Quantifying a phenomenon and using data science methods to establish a more detailed categorical system can be as productive.
candidates.sentence: In this respect, cultural analytics is the opposite of the movement in structuralism to reduce the variety of cultural phenomena to a small number of fundamental structures and binary oppositions (de Saussure, Lévi- Strauss, Greimas).
candidates.after: Instead of such reduction, cultural analytics wants to multiply and diversify categories, replace rigid categories by fuzzy ones, and recategorize the phenomena using computational methods.
